main_text.p: hic, ut fcholæ loquuntur, non fuerit fi- nis operantis: nemo autem mihi perfua- deat hunc finem hujus operis non efse.

Qui Hiftorias fcribunt ut decet, res geftas quemadmodum geftæ funt, narrant, nihil de fuo addunt, nihil detrahunt vel caute diffimulant, nihil importuna exafpe- ratione vel exofa emollitione invertunt. Sed, præfracte ac jurato quasi contraria omnia agit Spanhemius; nec recte de ho- rum malorum origine, nec recte de cau- fis, pejus autem de rebus geftis, & peffi- me de remediis fcribit.

Veram originem progressumque hujus mali persequatur aliquis, si ab æmula- tionibus quæ Academias inter Trajecten- sem ad Rhenum & Lugduno Batavam fue- runt perpetuæ, tanquam fonte derivanda statuerit. Ab ipsis incunabulis in illa di- versa prorsus methodo studia instituebant- tur, ac in ista consueverant. Trajectini Ductore Celeberr. D. page.notes: Printed text is a single column; the "C 5" signature and "ban-" catchword are at the foot. Possible uncertainties: "Lugduno" and "exafpe-" are as printed; "ftudia" and "lingua" read with long-s rendered as s. Greek and Hebrew words are rendered in Latin transliteration as printed (Hebræa, Græca) and no Greek letters appear on this page.
